title: Enhancement request — existing customer
summary: A change to a product Northwind already runs for a known customer. The request joins a fixed sprint. There is no onboarding, discovery, scope workshop, or customer proposal.

cadence.detail: Two-week sprint. Intake locks at sprint planning, every other Monday 09:00 America/New_York. Release window is Thursday of week 2 at 15:00 America/New_York. Work is accepted into the current sprint only when estimation and finance approval finish before planning lock; otherwise it waits for the next sprint. No separate kickoff.

criteria: Customer id already exists in the KYC book of record
Product id already exists for that customer
Request type is an enhancement, defect, or regulatory tweak to that product
No open severity-1 incident on that product
Started in Lead's chat with the intake card

stages.name: Intake
stages.sla: Acknowledge in Lead's chat within 4 business hours

stages.name: Estimation
stages.sla: 2 business days, and before sprint-planning lock

stages.name: Finance approval
stages.sla: 2 business days. Required on every enhancement, including work inside the sprint envelope. No bot may record this decision.

stages.name: Security and compliance approval
stages.humanApprover: Security officer or AI red-team lead
stages.sla: 3 business days. Security runs on every change. One human signature of kind red_team or security opens the iteration gate. A bot signature does not.

stages.name: Build
stages.sla: Inside the committed sprint. Builder does not merge.

stages.name: Test gate
stages.sla: Before the sprint release window. A failed report returns the request to build. Lead records the result and does not waive a security finding.

stages.name: Release gate
stages.sla: Sprint release window, Thursday of week 2 at 15:00 America/New_York. Human go/no-go in the request thread.
